/*getDeptSelect*/
SELECT ROWNUM NUM ,X.NODE_KEY ,X.LTEXT FROM( SELECT B. NODE_KEY , B. LTEXT FROM COWAY_BUDGET_ORG_ET_TREE B WHERE ISFOLDER IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT NVL (A.GROUP1 , A. BGORG_F) GROUP1 FROM COWAY_ORG_AUTHORITY_ET_DATA A, ICOMLUSR C WHERE A. PERNR = C.LEGACY_USER_ID AND KOKRS = '2000' AND C. USER_ID = #{st_user_id} UNION SELECT NVL (A.E_KOSTL , A. E_BGORG) GROUP1 FROM COWAY_LOGON_ID_TO_MP A, ICOMLUSR C WHERE A. E_PERNR = C.LEGACY_USER_ID AND C. USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) A WHERE (( A.GROUP1 = B .AUKOS OR A.GROUP1 = B. BGORG ) OR (A.GROUP1 = 'ROOT' AND 1=1) ) ) AND AUART = 'BGAT' ORDER BY BGORG ASC ) X WHERE 1 =1
AND X.NODE_KEY LIKE '%'||#{dept_cd}||'%'
AND X.LTEXT LIKE '%'||#{dept_nm}||'%'

/*getAAA*/
SELECT ROWNUM NUM ,X.NODE_KEY CODE ,'['||X.NODE_KEY||']'||X.LTEXT AS TEXT1 FROM( SELECT B. NODE_KEY , B. LTEXT FROM COWAY_BUDGET_ORG_ET_TREE B WHERE ISFOLDER IS NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 'X' FROM ( SELECT NVL (A.GROUP1 , A. BGORG_F) GROUP1 FROM COWAY_ORG_AUTHORITY_ET_DATA A, ICOMLUSR C WHERE A. PERNR = C.LEGACY_USER_ID AND KOKRS = '2000' AND C. USER_ID = #{st_user_id} UNION SELECT NVL (A.E_KOSTL , A. E_BGORG) GROUP1 FROM COWAY_LOGON_ID_TO_MP A, ICOMLUSR C WHERE A. E_PERNR = C.LEGACY_USER_ID AND C. USER_ID = #{st_user_id} ) A WHERE (( A.GROUP1 = B .AUKOS OR A.GROUP1 = B. BGORG ) OR (A.GROUP1 = 'ROOT' AND 1=1) ) ) AND AUART = 'BGAT' ORDER BY BGORG ASC ) X WHERE 1 =1

/*getBuyerCartQty*/
SELECT COUNT(A.USER_ID) CNT FROM ICOMCART A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C, CMSCATLG D WHERE B.BUYER = C.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER AND B.CMS_CATLG_ID = D.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND D.STD_FLAG(+)='Y' AND A.USE_FLAG = 'C' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND C.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','Y') AND A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id}

/*getCod2M039DDLB*/
SELECT CODE , TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE 1=1 AND TYPE = 'M039' AND FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY TEXT1

/*getCod2M040DDLB*/
SELECT CODE , TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE 1=1 AND TYPE = 'M040' AND FLAG = 'Y' ORDER BY TEXT1

/* getBuyerMpSHolidayPurchase */ SELECT ROWNUM RN, X.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTNUM FROM (
SELECT A.BUYER , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.CONTRACT_NO , B.CONTRACT_SEQ , 'C' USE_FLAG , 1 CART_QTY , B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , A.DESCRIPTION_LOC DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.MIN_QTY_RATE MIN_QTY , A.MAX_QTY_RATE MAX_QTY , NVL(B.MAX_QTY_RATE, 0) DEDUCT_RATE , B.UNIT_PRICE , B.AGENT , A.IMGFILE_DIR , A.IMGFILE_NAME , NVL(A.DOC_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) DOC_NO FROM ICOMBYIT A , ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER =#{buyer } AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBYCA CA, ICOMBYIT IT WHERE CA.COM_CODE = IT.BUYER AND CA.COM_CODE = a.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = a.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.CATEGORY_NO = CA.STD_CATEG_ID AND CA.CATEG_NAME = '명절선물세트') AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') BETWEEN FROM_DATE AND TO_DATE ORDER BY A.DESCRIPTION_LOC ) X

/* getBuyerMpSoGroupPurchase */ SELECT ROWNUM RN, A.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTNUM FROM ( SELECT MIN(BUYER)BUYER , MIN(BUYER_ITEM_NO)BUYER_ITEM_NO , MIN(CONTRACT_NO)CONTRACT_NO , MIN(CONTRACT_SEQ )CONTRACT_SEQ , MIN(USE_FLAG)USE_FLAG , MIN(CART_QTY)CART_QTY , MIN(BELOW_COMORG_CODE)BELOW_COMORG_CODE , MIN(DESCRIPTION)DESCRIPTION , TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(REPLACE(WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(SPECIFICATION), '@@,', '@@'),0, LENGTH(REPLACE(WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(SPECIFICATION), '@@,', '@@'))-2)) SPECIFICATION , TO_CHAR(REPLACE(WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(BUYER_ITEM_NO), ',', '@@')) RPRSNT_ITEM_NO , MIN(MIN_QTY)MIN_QTY , MIN(MAX_QTY)MAX_QTY , MIN(DEDUCT_RATE)DEDUCT_RATE , MIN(UNIT_PRICE) UNIT_PRICE , MIN(AGENT) AGENT , MAX(IMGFILE_DIR) AS IMGFILE_DIR , MAX(IMGFILE_NAME) AS IMGFILE_NAME , doc_no FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.CONTRACT_NO , B.CONTRACT_SEQ , 'C' USE_FLAG , 1 CART_QTY , B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , A.DESCRIPTION_LOC DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION||'@@'SPECIFICATION , A.MIN_QTY_RATE MIN_QTY , A.MAX_QTY_RATE MAX_QTY , NVL(B.MAX_QTY_RATE, 0) DEDUCT_RATE , B.UNIT_PRICE , B.AGENT , A.IMGFILE_DIR , A.IMGFILE_NAME , NVL(A.DOC_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) DOC_NO FROM ICOMBYIT A , ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER = #{buyer } AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBYCA CA, ICOMBYIT IT WHERE CA.COM_CODE = IT.BUYER AND CA.COM_CODE = a.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = a.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.CATEGORY_NO = CA.STD_CATEG_ID AND CA.CATEG_NAME = '공동구매') AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') BETWEEN FROM_DATE AND TO_DATE ) GROUP BY DOC_NO ) A

/* getNewDoctorBatchOrderCatalog */ SELECT ROWNUM RN , A.* , COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTNUM FROM ( SELECT MIN(BUYER)BUYER , MIN(BUYER_ITEM_NO)BUYER_ITEM_NO , MIN(CONTRACT_NO)CONTRACT_NO , MIN(CONTRACT_SEQ )CONTRACT_SEQ , MIN(USE_FLAG)USE_FLAG , MIN(CART_QTY)CART_QTY , MIN(BELOW_COMORG_CODE)BELOW_COMORG_CODE , MIN(DESCRIPTION)DESCRIPTION , TO_CHAR(SUBSTR(REPLACE(WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(SPECIFICATION), '@@,', '@@'),0, LENGTH(REPLACE(WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(SPECIFICATION), '@@,', '@@'))-4)) SPECIFICATION , TO_CHAR(REPLACE(WMSYS.WM_CONCAT(BUYER_ITEM_NO), ',', '@@')) RPRSNT_ITEM_NO , MIN(MIN_QTY)MIN_QTY , MIN(MAX_QTY)MAX_QTY , MIN(DEDUCT_RATE)DEDUCT_RATE , MIN(UNIT_PRICE) UNIT_PRICE , MIN(AGENT) AGENT , DOC_NO FROM ( SELECT A.BUYER , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.CONTRACT_NO , B.CONTRACT_SEQ , 'C' USE_FLAG , 1 CART_QTY , B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , A.DESCRIPTION_LOC DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION||'@@'SPECIFICATION , A.MIN_QTY_RATE MIN_QTY , A.MAX_QTY_RATE MAX_QTY , NVL(B.MAX_QTY_RATE, 0) DEDUCT_RATE , B.UNIT_PRICE , B.AGENT , NVL(A.DOC_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) DOC_NO FROM ICOMBYIT A , ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND A.BUYER = #{buyer } AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBYCA CA, ICOMBYIT IT WHERE CA.COM_CODE = IT.BUYER AND CA.COM_CODE = a.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = a.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.CATEGORY_NO = CA.STD_CATEG_ID AND CA.CATEG_NAME = '신규닥터 일괄주문') AND A.STATUS != 'D' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'yyyyMMdd') BETWEEN FROM_DATE AND TO_DATE ) GROUP BY DOC_NO ) A

/* getBuyerMpSoSellerRegList */ SELECT ROWNUM RN, X.*, COUNT(*) OVER() AS TOTNUM FROM (
SELECT A.BUYER , A.BUYER_ITEM_NO , B.CONTRACT_NO , B.CONTRACT_SEQ , 'O' USE_FLAG , 1 CART_QTY , B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE , A.DESCRIPTION_LOC DESCRIPTION , A.SPECIFICATION , A.MIN_QTY_RATE MIN_QTY , A.MAX_QTY_RATE MAX_QTY , NVL(B.MAX_QTY_RATE, 0) DEDUCT_RATE , B.UNIT_PRICE , B.AGENT , A.IMGFILE_DIR , A.IMGFILE_NAME , NVL(A.DOC_NO, A.BUYER_ITEM_NO) DOC_NO FROM ICOMBYIT A , ICOMCQDT B WHERE A.BUYER = #{byca_comorg_code } AND B.BELOW_COMORG_CODE =#{buyer } AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ICOMBYCA CA, ICOMBYIT IT, ICOMCOD2 COD WHERE CA.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND CA.COM_CODE = IT.BUYER AND IT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND IT.CATEGORY_NO = CA.STD_CATEG_ID AND CA.COM_CODE = COD.TEXT1 AND CA.CATEG_NAME = COD.TEXT2 AND COD.TYPE = 'M018' AND COD.CODE = 'C001' AND COD.FLAG = 'Y' ) AND A.STATUS != 'D' ORDER BY A.DESCRIPTION_LOC ) X
